summary: A PowerShell process spawned by winword.exe on WS-FIN-042 executed an encoded command that downloaded a payload from 203.0.113.45. The user jdoe opened an invoice attachment shortly before the activity started.
attack_narrative: 1. jdoe opened invoice_4471.docm from an external email. 2. winword.exe spawned powershell.exe with -enc and -w hidden arguments (event 2). 3. PowerShell downloaded stage2.dll from http://203.0.113.45/s2 (event 3).
key_findings: Office application spawning PowerShell with an encoded command
Outbound connection to an IP address with no business justification
Macro-enabled document received from an external sender
recommended_actions: Reset the credentials of jdoe and review recent sign-ins
Block 203.0.113.45 at the perimeter and search for other hosts that contacted it
open_questions: Was stage2.dll executed and is it still present on the host?
Did other mailboxes receive the same attachment?
